WITH RECURSIVE temp AS ( SELECT code, name, cast(budgetlevel as integer) as level, ARRAY[name::text] as path_arr FROM tb_budget_category WHERE parent_code = '0'
UNION ALL
SELECT t.code, t.name, cast(t.budgetlevel as integer) as level, r.path_arr || t.name::text as path_arr FROM tb_budget_category t INNER JOIN temp r ON t.parent_code = r.code ) , ACC_LIST AS ( -- 3. 최종 출력 SELECT a.code as budget_code, REPEAT(' ', a.level - 1) || a.name AS name_view, -- 시각적 들여쓰기 a.level, array_to_string(a.path_arr, ' > ') AS full_path, b.code as acc_code, b.name as acc_name, b.dr_cr_div as dr_cr FROM temp a inner join tb_account_category b on a.code = b.budget_code where 1=1 and b.code in ( select c.acc_code from tb_slip_detail c inner join tb_slip_header d on c.slip_id = d.slip_id where 1=1 and d.status = '2' -- 승인완료 건만 ) ) select acc_code, concat('[', full_path, ']', acc_name) as acc_name, dr_cr from ACC_LIST order by acc_code
